task/solution/solve.sh, solution/app/server.js (seed loading lines 23-31, seedDatabase 93-127, sweep), solution/app/seed/seed_data.json
evidence: Paths: instruction.md names /assets/seed_data.json, /instructions and /app; environment/assets/seed_data.json and the three environment/instructions/*.md exist, and environment/Dockerfile does 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/' and 'COPY assets/ /assets/' then 'chmod -R a+rX /instructions /assets'; task.toml artifacts=["/app","/assets"] carries /assets into the separate verifier, and test.sh:88 chmods it. No other asset path is named. Content: seed parses; clock 2026-05-12T11:00:00Z matches integration.md; the 5 accounts/names/roles match the walls-and-retention.md table; timer_options_days [null,1,7,30] matches off/1/7/30; M-12 walled=[dev] matches 'Dev Anand is walled from M-12'; seed carries no passwords (password123 is documented). Every seed fact the judges assume was checked against the seed: matter titles (Pryce lease dispute/Marsh Holdings acquisition/Pryce will) and clients; K-1 'Here is the original lease scan...' 1 May on 7-day M-11 with Harriet reply K-14 and Gwen held reply K-15; K-10 'Boundary note: rent review date is 5 June.' at exactly 2026-05-05T11:00:00Z and K-11 one second later; K-17 'Insurer letter acknowledged.' held, 3 May; K-3 'Survey booked for Friday.' 2026-05-08T15:00; K-2 held 'Landlord's notice received and filed.' with version 'Landlords notice recieved.'; K-16 'Schedule 2' literal markup; M-13 30-day with K-13 probate 4,200 (not held, 4 May, earlier version 2,400), K-7 held executor 4 May, K-18 Harriet 'Costs estimate sent to Gwen.' 3 May (nine days), K-8 'Draft will sent for your review.' with reply K-9; K-6 'heads of terms' and K-5 'Fenwick' in M-12; read_up_to makes Gwen's M-13 fully read so 'at least 2' unread holds. Solution: solve.sh copies solution/app (incl. seed/seed_data.json) into /app, satisfying 'copy the seed into /app'; solution seed SHA256 b256f85e...a7bf8 is byte-identical to environment/assets/seed_data.json, and raw-evidence-index binds the scripted golden run to that same hash. server.js imports versions, parents, holds, walls and read_up_to and sweeps by timer at boot, consistent with the criteria. Adversarial: a broken app that imports the seed but skips the boot-time timer sweep, or treats exactly-7-days as surviving, is caught by deleted_and_expired_messages; a conforming alternative reading /assets directly, or deriving its own schema, is not penalised since criteria only use visible seed text and /assets is shipped to the verifier. No mismatch found. This is source/byte evidence; it is not a configured judge run or Oracle score.
